steps.name: Doll Street Cleanup!
steps.objective: Defeat [Symbol of Peace Pin] and [Heart Pirates Navigators] on the "Doll Street", then report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Welcome to Chunsik Land, where dreams and hopes come true!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Where, exactly?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Excuse me... who are you?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Are you here with the construction crew?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xenon sent me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said you needed someone to clear things out...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, the adventurer I've heard so much about?!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh my, oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I was expecting some muscle-bound monster with three heads...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But you're adorable! Hehehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of rumors are people spreading about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I've got a lot to do, you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you'd just tell me what you need!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: So prickly. That just makes you cuter.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Your job is simple.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Apparently, someone cast a spell on this place...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And now the statues and mascots are all moving around.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: They're running wild, so we can't get any work done for the reopening.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that... So it's still in effect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, you're remodeling Chunsik Land and reopening it?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, that's my job.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: At first, I tried negotiating with them about permanent employment...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But they completely ignored me!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I can't possibly do all this alone while things are like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you'd like my help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do with the moving mascot figures?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Herd them into one place, or tie them up so they can't move...?

steps.name: Outlaws of the Memorial Hall 1
steps.objective: Defeat [Knight of Light Bong Chunsik] in the "Chunsik Land Memorial Hall", then report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Could you do that for now?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I've met plenty of visitors, but you're the first to say anything like that!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Nobody else offered to do what you just did.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Amazing. You dealt with all those mascot figures... It would have taken me several more days.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You're incredibly efficient. Any interest in Chunsik Land? How would you like to work here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. I'll just stick to this job.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm kidding. Anyway, now I need you to clear out the memorial hall.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That place is so revolting I don't even want to go inside.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Where did they come up with so many ugly characters with such bizarre backstories...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you end up working in a place like this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: One day, the owner came to my old workplace and offered me a new job.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The salary was good...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And above all, he promised not to interfere with my work and to give me all the support I needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those are amazing terms!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Exactly. Before I knew it, I'd signed the contract he was waving in front of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh dear...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Anyway, please hurry and clear out the Chunsik Land Memorial Hall.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm going to empty it completely and fill it with new attractions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. It shouldn't be too difficult...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Outlaws of the Memorial Hall 2
steps.objective: Defeat the [Beat Band] and [Fairy Bear Strong] in the "Chunsik Land Memorial Hall", then report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

steps.name: Outlaws of the Memorial Hall 3
steps.objective: Defeat [Bong], [Chun], and [Sik] in the "Chunsik Land Memorial Hall", then report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

steps.name: Ice Cream Garden Cleanup 1
steps.objective: Report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby" about the [Snowball Character Trio] in the "Ice Cream Garden".

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You've cleared everything out nicely, even the Bong Chunsik Special Forces.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Good work.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That should be enough for the memorial hall for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's still more in there I could sweep away...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I think we should deal with the biggest problems first.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now, next is the Ice Cream Garden.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: For something the owner came up with, the concept is actually rather good...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: So I'm adding more ideas to bring the quality up.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But the characters there are causing trouble too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you want me to clear that place out as well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just the big ones?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Exactly. No need to bother with every little thing.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just deal with the big ones.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We can gather up the smaller ones and dispose of them all at once.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's how cleaning works.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Still, they're characters that are alive and moving around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calling them trash is pretty cold.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If they didn't want to be treated that way, they should at least have pretended to consider my offer seriously.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's not as if I was offering peanuts and planning to work them like servants.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The terms were excellent, and they completely ignored them!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Why are you getting angry at me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going.

steps.name: Ice Cream Garden Cleanup 2
steps.objective: Report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby" about the [Petit Milky Way Character Trio] in the "Ice Cream Garden".

steps.name: Ice Cream Garden Cleanup 3
steps.objective: Defeat [Ancient Calorie] in the "Ice Cream Garden", then report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleanup 1
steps.objective: Defeat all three members of the [Practice Sketch Trio] drawn by Bong Chunsik in the "Book of Shadows".

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now all that's left is the Book of Shadows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of place is that?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's something like the owner's private library...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And it's in chaos too, thanks to a spell, or a curse... some strange magic, anyway.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Hmm. If I had to describe that place in a single phrase...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A single phrase...?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: A complete collection of his most embarrassing phases?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's how I see it, though the owner seems to think it's a treasure trove.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Once you go inside, you'll find all sorts of books and paintings flying around.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And there's a dragon with some painfully melodramatic backstory making a racket...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? A melodramatic dragon?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You'll understand when you see it.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Clear that place out too.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Every. Last. Bit.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's a filthy place full of nothing but scribbles pretending to be art!

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleanup 2
steps.objective: Defeat all three members of the [Graffiti Bug Trio] created by Bong Chunsik in the "Book of Shadows".

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleanup 3
steps.objective: Put [Dark Flame Lord Black Flame Dragon], the character created by Bong Chunsik in the "Book of Shadows", to rest.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You really do get things done properly.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Actually, when Detective Xenon recommended you, he couldn't stop singing your praises.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: He said you'd worked together on many cases and had never made a single mistake...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Anyway, thanks to you, we can finally get serious about preparing Chunsik Land to reopen.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just did the job I was asked to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I was thinking while I worked. Why not change the name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chunsik Land... Isn't it a little tacky?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I thought so too... but the owner is adamant about that.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: He said he wouldn't change it even with a knife to his throat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh dear...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Still, if the attractions and service are good, plenty of people will come!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, when you're done adventuring, come see me if you're looking for something to do.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll hire you on excellent terms! Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks for the offer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I still have things to do.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's someone I need to meet. I don't know when I'll be able to, though...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'm busy, so I'd better go.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Of course! Have a safe trip!
